status_note: Manifest for Shadow Masque's in-game AI rival and its production agent team. As of 2026-11-24 the PPO rival code (agents/rl, tools/rl), the macro layer and the versus runner are on branch orch/preview, and the evaluation suite (evaluation/, tools/eval) is on orch/wip-T08 (untested, unreviewed). None of them is on main yet. No trained weights exist yet. Entries say where each artifact lives.
purpose: Drive one rival seat in a two-rival stealth duel: choose bounded macro-actions from that seat's own partial observation, compared against a scripted pathfinding baseline on the same interface.
tools_available: macro-actions only: BLEND, DISGUISE, WAIT, FOLLOW, STRIKE, FLEE, CLIMB, SEARCH, RIG_TRAP (decision #23; RIG_TRAP masked until traps are integrated)
the seat's own legal-action list, used as the action mask
prohibited_actions: read the GameState, the other seat's observation, the RNG seed, guard scripts, trap ownership or other rooms
tell a disguised rival from a guard by anything a human could not see
act outside its own seat or submit outcomes instead of inputs
read held-out evaluation scenarios during training
make network or paid model calls
memory_policy: Per-seat, per-duel encoder history only (last macro and its state, rooms seen, per-figure tells matched by place; capped counters, no clock). Reset with each duel. Nothing persists between duels or between seats.

model_choice.default_mode: scripted baseline until a trained policy passes Gate 2 (agents/versus_baseline.py, orch/preview)
model_choice.in_game_model: Small PPO policy we train ourselves (decision #3, 2026-11-23): actor-critic MLP 2x64 tanh, masked softmax; pure-Python stdlib inference, argmax over allowed macros
model_choice.weights: plain JSON 'sm-ppo-mlp-1', loaded only with its recorded SHA-256 (agents/rl/policy.py:load_net). None yet: full training not started
model_choice.training: tools/rl/train.py, numpy, fixed seeds; full run needs Saad's approval
model_choice.legacy_llm_player: agents/model_player.py with Claude Haiku 4.5 via POP_MODEL (midterm rival; not the G2/G3 rival). Paid calls capped under $1 total, smoke only (decision #8)
model_choice.development_assistants: Claude Code: Production Orchestrator on claude-opus-5-5 (main session) and named workers on claude-sonnet-5-5; see agent_team

prompts_or_system_instructions: N/A for the PPO rival (no prompt). Legacy LLM player: agents/model_player.py system prompt.
named_failure_modes: hidden-state leak through features, mask, ids, ordering or errors
over-fitting to the two tuning starts
inference error or timeout (labelled WAIT fallback)
stale macro after the state changed (re-validated each decision)
weights file tampered or mismatched (SHA-256 refusal)
no way down a floor in the macro vocabulary (GATE-T05-eval; T05-fix1 WIP)
evaluation_cases: Deterministic tests: tests/test_rl_encoder.py, tests/test_rl_policy.py, tests/test_rl_train.py, tests/test_versus_runner.py, leak tests (orch/preview). Scenario suite D1, B2, I3, F5 (tuning) and H6 (held-out, frozen) with Saad's success definitions (decision #9): evaluation/ and tools/eval/run_versus_suite.py (orch/wip-T08, unreviewed).
logging_policy: Per-run results JSON with commit, controller names and versions, weights hash, seat, outcome, termination, success flag, metrics, invalid/stale/fallback/busy counts, latency and trace paths. Two-seat traces replay to the same final snapshot. Provider, token and cost fields are N/A for the PPO rival. No player data or credentials.
human_override_points: human takes either seat at any time (same engine.step)
choose the scripted baseline as the rival
quit or rematch with the same seed
native_artifact: .claude/skills/evaluate-rival/SKILL.md (executable evaluation extension); agents/rl/policy.py:make_rl_rival (callable rival interface, orch/preview)
fallback: Inference error or runner failure gives a labelled WAIT ('source': 'fallback'), counted per seat; a run over its fallback limit is reported as aborted, never dropped.
limitations: Untrained: no weights yet, so no strength claim is possible.
Policy chooses when to act; the target is fixed to the nearest figure that is not downed.
Only two tuning starts: expect over-fitting.
In the static web build the full state lives in the browser, so devtools can read hidden state; acceptable for human vs AI, not for online human vs human.
Most rival and evaluation code is on orch/preview or WIP branches, not main.
